name: Ryoku
source:
A Shikigami of the forest activated by the green paper. Although she is a strategist who has the role of a strategy staff who supports combat in the rear, she is worried that the technique is slow to activate and lacks speed. She has a very gentle and gentle sister-like personality. Sedate and calm, very fast-moving and nifty. As the leader of the three shikigami, she always cares for the immature Shak. She tends to suppress my emotions.

[from Getchu]
